$comment: Contract and Syndra constants an add-on never declares. Every duration is ISO 8601.

max_reply_bytes.meaning: The largest reply Syndra reads (1 MiB); it bounds a /subjects reply and a /stats page.

call_memory.meaning: How long an add-on remembers a call, at least.

in_doubt_bound.meaning: How long a call may stay in_doubt before it becomes a human's item.

series_per_metric.meaning: The most series Syndra keeps for one metric.

cooldown_default.meaning: fresh_read_cooldown when a manifest declares none.
